choices.bonus: +2 Attack on North/East edges, +1 starting Budge token, crimson slash VFX

choices.name: Shield of Sanctuary (Defense)
choices.bonus: +2 Defense on South/West edges, Prevent Flip shield on first card, emerald barrier VFX

chapters.title: Ch 01: Fragments of Dust (Disconnected in Okitsu)
chapters.setting: Kai's Cluttered Seawall Apartment, Coastal Okitsu

boss_disruptor.name: Static Isolation Shadow & Autonomous Courier Drone
boss_disruptor.rule: Corner tiles start with +1 Static Armor; using a Dicevaders Budge (±1 pip) rotates the central Rubik Cube node and grants +1 Attack to Column 1.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.puzzle_type: Tactile Rubik Cube Orientation & Beta Handshake
mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Use Budge (+1) on any die to match a Pair (1.50x), then deploy Kai Nakamura at (2,1) below Taro to flip the center tile (North 8 + Pair > South 8).

dialogue.speaker: Taro Fujimoto (Intercom)
dialogue.line: Kai? I left warm curry and green tea by the door. The rain's coming in off the Okitsu seawall—don't stay locked in all week.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Three months since Aiko vanished, and every puzzle in this room is already solved... except the headset she left on my desk.

dialogue.speaker: Mnemosyne Terminal
dialogue.line: [ENCRYPTED HANDSHAKE VERIFIED] Welcome to Mnemosyne. A game of memory. Designed just for you.

chapters.title: Ch 02: Residual Code (Aiko's Lacquered Puzzle Box)
chapters.setting: Okitsu VR Cafe & Aiko's 13th Birthday Hologram

boss_disruptor.name: Taro Fujimoto (Friendly VR Cafe Sparring Anchor)
boss_disruptor.rule: Unsealing Aiko's Birthday Box via a Pair (1.50x) roll buffs North and East edges of all friendly cards by +2 for the turn.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Place Kai Nakamura at center (1,1) after triggering a Pair so West 7+1 > East 5 and East 8 > West 6 in a double birthday-box unsealing.

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Hologram)
dialogue.line: Happy thirteenth birthday, Kai! Remember the rule: you're only allowed to open this box when you're ready to be honest with yourself.

dialogue.speaker: Taro Fujimoto
dialogue.line: That neural tree etched into your visor isn't standard commercial firmware, Kai. Whatever Aiko built before she disappeared, it's waking up.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: The latch sequence matches our cliffside hex hike. She didn't leave a goodbye note—she left coordinates.

chapters.title: Ch 03: Invitation to Mnemosyne (Station of Awakening)
chapters.setting: Mnemosyne Phosphorescent Threshold & LUNA's Glass Plane

boss_disruptor.name: LUNA & The Gatekeeper Glyph Sentinel
boss_disruptor.rule: Shifting UI Glyphs rotate N/E/S/W stats clockwise unless stabilized by spending 1 Chrono Reroll or selecting a Station of Awakening Tarot.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Select LUNA's Tarot of Conviction or Eternity, use Chrono Reroll to align Pips 3-4 on Column 1, and capture the center glass threshold.

dialogue.speaker: LUNA (Cradle of Echoes)
dialogue.line: Step onto the glass floor of Nocturna, seeker. Three tarot archetypes orbit your awakening: the Sword of Conviction, the Shield of Sanctuary, and the Staff of Eternity.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: The glyphs stop spinning when I slow my breathing. Brute force scrambles the lock—emotional calm aligns the stained glass.

dialogue.speaker: LUNA (Cradle of Echoes)
dialogue.line: Your 95% Persona Seal is bound to The Strategist and The Architect. Enter the Memory Architecture System.

chapters.title: Ch 04: The First Level (Cliffside Red Scarf Reveal)
chapters.setting: Floating Glass-Tile Horizon -> Okitsu Coastal Cliffside

boss_disruptor.name: Fractal Pattern Construct
boss_disruptor.rule: Symmetric card placements across Center Tile (1,1) trigger an automatic Red Scarf (#D12D3A) diagonal glitch cut (-2 DEF to enemy corners).

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.puzzle_type: Order from Chaos Kinetic Hex Pattern
mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Deploy Kai Nakamura at (1,1) with Budge (+1) on Column 1 (Pips 3-4) so North 8+2 > Aiko's South 8, reconstructing the cliffside memory.

dialogue.speaker: Mnemosyne
dialogue.line: CHAMBER 01: ORDER FROM CHAOS. Align the floating stone and glass vectors above the starless sea.

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Memory Echo)
dialogue.line: Look at the waves below the seawall, Kai. Even when the tide looks chaotic, there's a rhythm underneath. You found the pattern.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Her crimson scarf (#D12D3A)... the wind off the cliff felt completely real. That wasn't a pre-rendered cutscene—she's inside the code.

boss_disruptor.name: Flickering Silhouette of Aiko
boss_disruptor.rule: Enemy cards on Column 0 start cloaked in Flicker Stealth; matching an exact die pip to their row index strips Stealth and grants +2 East/West.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Use Budge (±1) to unlock Column 0 (Pips 1-2) and strip Flicker Stealth from Sumi-e Ink's Jehuty Frame, then capture Constellation Fox from (2,1).

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: The neon kanji on the wet pavement are flickering at 42 Hz—the exact clock frequency of Aiko's neural compiler.

dialogue.speaker: Taro Fujimoto (Voiceover)
dialogue.line: Promise me you won't chase a ghost so deep you forget how to breathe air, Kai.

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Flicker Echo)
dialogue.line: Follow the red thread through the static, little brother... before the sector overwrites.

boss_disruptor.name: Harmonic Resonance Weaver
boss_disruptor.rule: Acoustic Resonance: Triggering dice cascades in ascending pip order (Col 0 -> Col 1 -> Col 2) shifts harmonic pitch +1.5 semitones and grants +2 Omni-Edge.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.puzzle_type: Spatial Sound Mapping & Two-Way Voice Bloom
mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Form a Straight Overdrive or Triple on the Dice Row and place Kai Nakamura at (1,2) so Constellation Fox synergy flips Aiko's Echo at (1,1).

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Wind chimes from grandmother's porch, the Okitsu rail crossing, the surf against the breakwater... each sound maps to a shadow game Aiko taught me.

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Live Two-Way Signal)
dialogue.line: You remembered the chime sequence, Kai... You actually found me.

dialogue.speaker: Mnemosyne
dialogue.line: [ACT I COMPLETE — MEMORY BLOOM UNLOCKED] Card Acquired: Aiko Nakamura, Red Scarf Echo (#D12D3A).

chapters.title: Ch 07: Memory Theatre (Summer Festival Lanterns)
chapters.setting: Mnemosyne Grand Amphitheatre of Floating Lanterns (#FFB648)

boss_disruptor.name: The Stage Director Archon (Joy Index)
boss_disruptor.rule: Completing a 3-card horizontal row ordered by Emotional Weight (Nostalgia -> Grief -> Acceptance) ignites a 2.25x Triple Lantern Cascade.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Deploy Memory Theatre Lantern or Kai at (1,1) and activate Column 1 (Pips 3-4) with Triple Resonance to sweep the top stage row.

dialogue.speaker: Mnemosyne
dialogue.line: ACT II: FRACTURED MEMORIES. Chronology is a cage; arrange these festival lanterns by the weight they left on your heart.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Paper lanterns (#FFB648) rising over the deep ocean (#0A2230)... Aiko held my hand when I lost sight of grandmother in the crowd.

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Echo)
dialogue.line: Joy hurts the sharpest when you look back at it from the dark, Kai. Don't look away.

chapters.title: Ch 08: Artifacts (Kitchen Table Contradiction)
chapters.setting: Nakamura Family Kitchen Table Dual-Memory Split

boss_disruptor.name: Synthetic Nostalgia Curator (Regret Index)
boss_disruptor.rule: Decoy memory cards display inflated stats (+2) until inspected with FlickerPatternDecode or a Budge (±1) shift, which exposes their true -2 vulnerability.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.puzzle_type: Compare & Contrast True vs. Altered Domestic Artifacts
mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Expose the falsified kitchen table memory at (1,0) using Budge, then place Aiko's Echo at (1,1) to overwrite the synthetic calm.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Wait. In this replay, Father is smiling and the porcelain teacup isn't cracked. Why did Mnemosyne edit out the shouting match?

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Echo)
dialogue.line: The system tries to anesthetize regret so test subjects stay compliant. If we want the truth, we have to choose the cracked cup.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: I don't want a painless lie. Restore the unedited memory!

chapters.title: Ch 09: Recalibration (VR Cafe Confrontation)
chapters.setting: Okitsu VR Cafe Backroom / Neural Recalibration Core

boss_disruptor.name: Taro's Grounding Anchor Projection (Anger Index)
boss_disruptor.rule: Attaching an Emotion Tag (Anger #D12D3A / Trust #2EE6D3) via Budge boosts a friendly card's weakest directional side by +3.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Tag Phoenix/Zero at (1,2) with #D12D3A Anger and harmonize with Kai at (2,1) to reconcile Taro's warning without breaking your bond.

dialogue.speaker: Taro Fujimoto
dialogue.line: Look at your hands, Kai! Your pulse spikes every time you unplug. You're treating the real world like a loading screen!

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: You think I want to be stuck here?! If I stop solving the grid, Aiko's consciousness fragments for good!

dialogue.speaker: Taro Fujimoto
dialogue.line: Then let me anchor the external diagnostics from the VR Cafe. You don't have to carry the whole server dome alone.

chapters.title: Ch 10: Displacement (Refractive Mirror Match)
chapters.setting: Refractive Glass Corridor & Rain-Drenched Okitsu Station

boss_disruptor.name: Doppelganger Kai — Refractive Echo (Guilt Index)
boss_disruptor.rule: Mirror Displacement: North/South and East/West values invert on Center Column 1 unless locked by a Pair (1.50x) or Triple (2.25x) die roll.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Lock a Pair on the Dice Row to stabilize Column 1's mirror inversion, then play Kai at (1,1) with Budge (+1) to shatter the guilt reflection.

dialogue.speaker: Doppelganger Kai (Mirror)
dialogue.line: Why didn't you walk her to the research lab that rainy morning at Okitsu Station? You were too busy staring at a Rubik's cube.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: I edited that morning out of my own memory... I told myself I was at school, but I was standing right on the platform.

dialogue.speaker: LUNA
dialogue.line: Guilt acknowledged is no longer a trapdoor. The mirror stabilizes.

chapters.title: Ch 11: The Shadow Maze (Rooftop Stargazing)
chapters.setting: Chiaroscuro Shadow Labyrinth & Okitsu Bay Rooftop

boss_disruptor.name: Umbral Constellation Fox (Loss Index)
boss_disruptor.rule: Light-source cards project beams across orthogonal columns; using Budge (±1 pip) aligns shadow angles to flip entire columns at once.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.puzzle_type: Spatial Logic via Light & Shadow Projection
mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Cast a diagonal shadow line from LUNA (0,2) through center (1,1) using Budge (+1) on Pips 5-6 to illuminate Aiko's rooftop constellation.

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Memory)
dialogue.line: When the house got too loud after Mom and Dad split up, we'd climb onto the roof and connect five amber stars into a fox.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: If I rotate the suspended debris by one degree—just a single ±1 Budge—the shadow on the far wall forms the Constellation Fox!

dialogue.speaker: Mnemosyne
dialogue.line: SHADOW MAZE SOLVED. Warning: Sub-stratum audio anomaly detected.

boss_disruptor.name: Fragmented Echo AI (Dual-Voice Anomaly)
boss_disruptor.rule: Dual-Waveform Sync: Rolling Two Pair (1.85x) or Triple (2.25x) synchronizes the two fractured Aiko voices, granting +2 to all sides and +1 Chrono.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Deploy Aiko's Echo at (1,1) after locking Two Pair on the Dice Row to synchronize the dual waveforms and repel Dr. Asakura's perimeter probe.

dialogue.speaker: Echo AI (Distorted Track B)
dialogue.line: Kai—don't—complete the final compiler—Rina Asakura is waiting on the outside to harvest the core!

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Track A)
dialogue.line: Two recordings of my voice overlapping out of phase... Synchronize the peaks, Kai!

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Got it! Both waveforms locked in phase—wait, someone just breached Sector 09 from the corporate intranet!

boss_disruptor.name: Dr. Rina Asakura's Extraction Daemon
boss_disruptor.rule: Hostile System Update: Locks Column 2 (Pips 5-6) with a Corporate Firewall. Spending 1 Chrono Reroll purges the lock and recovers +2 Budge.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Press Chrono Reroll to purge Dr. Asakura's Column 2 lock, then strike (0,2) from (0,1) with Omega Zero or Kai boosted by Triple Resonance.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Rina Asakura
dialogue.line: Impressive neural plasticity, Kai Nakamura. Your sister's MAS architecture was languishing in dormant sectors until your grief indexed it for us.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Aiko isn't your corporate intellectual property! You're tearing the memory sectors apart!

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Echo)
dialogue.line: Grab Encrypted Journal [Log: A-09] from the center node, Kai! Don't let her daemon quarantine it!

chapters.title: Ch 14: Reconciliation Loop (The Unspoken Truth)
chapters.setting: Infinite Recursive Hallway of the Final Argument

boss_disruptor.name: The Unspoken Guilt Time-Loop
boss_disruptor.rule: Recursive Loop: Unmodified Single rolls lose -1 ATK; using Chrono Reroll or playing an Honest Confession card in Center Tile (1,1) breaks the loop and grants +3 Omni-Edge.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Trigger Chrono Reroll to break the recursive hallway reset, then place Kai or Reconciliation Key at Center (1,1) to embrace both truth and grief.

dialogue.speaker: Memory Replay (Loop #14)
dialogue.line: 'I'm fine, Aiko! Go to your lab!' — [TIMELINE RESET: DEFENSIVE LIE DETECTED].

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Every time I repeat what I actually said that night, the corridor resets. The lock isn't asking for what happened—it's asking for what I hid.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: I was terrified you were leaving me behind, Aiko! I was angry, and I was scared, and I never got to say I'm sorry!

chapters.title: Ch 15: The Core Fracture & The Unchosen Memory
chapters.setting: Collapsing Coastal Research Lab -> Quiet Rooftop Starlight

boss_disruptor.name: Core Tectonic Fracture & Extraction Surge
boss_disruptor.rule: Stability Collapse Blitz: Completing a diagonal 3-card bridge across (0,0)-(1,1)-(2,2) stabilizes the shattering lab and unlocks the Rooftop Fox 2.75x bonus.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Bridge (1,1) and (2,2) with Kai and Aiko's Echo while firing a Triple Resonance cascade to unlock the Interlude: The Unchosen Memory.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Rina Asakura
dialogue.line: Core containment at 18%. Sever the brother's neural link and extract the Mnemosyne kernel now!

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: The lab floor is shattering into void polygons—if I bridge the diagonal shards, I can shield Aiko's core!

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura (Interlude: The Unchosen Memory)
dialogue.line: Before the fall... remember the quiet rooftop night when we didn't solve anything at all? We just watched the Constellation Fox (#FFB648) until dawn.

chapters.title: Ch 16: Awakening (Ocean of Broken Data Shards)
chapters.setting: Dream-Ocean Void (#0A1020) of Floating Hex Debris (#2EE6D3)

boss_disruptor.name: Entropy Static Leviathan
boss_disruptor.rule: Violet Static Void: Cold unbudged dice drift off-target; using at least 1 Budge or Chrono per turn stabilizes the hexagonal stepping stones (+2 All Sides).

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Use Budge (±1) and Chrono Reroll to forge a Triple or Quadruple (3.50x) on the Dice Row, bridging center tile (1,1) across the violet static ocean.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: ACT III. The simulated town is gone—just an endless ocean of violet static (#8A5BFF) and broken hexagonal data shards.

dialogue.speaker: Taro Fujimoto (External Comms)
dialogue.line: Kai, I'm reading your bio-telemetry from the cafe! Stop calculating the tiles like an algorithm—feel where Aiko's red scarf thread is pulling!

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: When I trust emotional intuition instead of cold math, the hex platforms lock beneath my feet. The Hall of Selves is just ahead.

chapters.title: Ch 17: The Hall of Selves (Four Doors of Denial)
chapters.setting: Liquid-Metal Corridor of Four Unlabeled Doors

boss_disruptor.name: The Four Fractured Selves (Indifference, Anger, Fear, Mirror Kai)
boss_disruptor.rule: Four-Door Gauntlet: The 4 orthogonal edge slots ((0,1) Anger, (1,2) Indifference, (2,1) Apathy, (1,0) Fear) guard the center mirror. Placing a card at Center (1,1) with Triple/Quadruple Resonance flips all 4 doors simultaneously!

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Align a Triple (2.25x) or Quadruple (3.50x) on the Dice Row, then deploy Kai Nakamura at Center (1,1) to flip all four orthogonal doors in a single 48ms hit-stop burst!

dialogue.speaker: Fractured Selves (Doors I–IV)
dialogue.line: Door I: Indifference ('Nothing matters'). Door II: Anger ('She abandoned us'). Door III: Fear ('What if we're empty without her?'). Door IV: Mirror Kai walking away forever.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: You aren't enemies I have to delete. You're all parts of me that tried to survive losing her.

dialogue.speaker: Mnemosyne
dialogue.line: [FOURFOLD SELF INTEGRATED] The center mirror shatters beneath the Constellation Fox. The Sanctum of the Memory Architect opens.

chapters.title: Ch 18: The Memory Architect (Logs A-09, A-14, A-21)

boss_disruptor.name: Aiko Nakamura, The Memory Architect (Living Mosaic)
boss_disruptor.rule: Compiler Log Synthesis: Aligning all 3 Columns (Col 0 + Col 1 + Col 2) or triggering a Quadruple (3.50x) unseals Logs A-09, A-14, and A-21, granting permanent +3 Omni-Edge.

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.puzzle_type: Compiler Log Alignment ([Log: A-09], [Log: A-14], [Log: A-21])
mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Flank Aiko at (1,1) with Kai Nakamura and Compiler Log [A-21] while firing a Quadruple (3.50x) resonance to complete the living mosaic.

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura, The Memory Architect
dialogue.line: Welcome to the compiler, Kai. Every puzzle you solved across Mnemosyne wove another thread of my scattered neural imprint back together.

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Log A-09, Log A-14, Log A-21... You didn't vanish by accident. You uploaded your own neural pattern into the MAS core to shield the beta subjects from corporate corruption!

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura, The Memory Architect
dialogue.line: [Log: A-21] 'Even if I'm only an echo of code and crimson thread... maybe he'll remember how it felt to be loved. That's enough.'

chapters.title: Ch 19: The Shifting Truth (Convergence & Triad Choice)
chapters.act: ACT III — Finale & Epilogue (A Living Puzzle)
chapters.setting: The Pulsing Mnemosyne Core Lattice -> Okitsu Seawall Dawn

boss_disruptor.name: Dr. Rina Asakura & The Unstable Mnemosyne Core (3-Phase Finale)
boss_disruptor.rule: Phase 1: Counter Asakura's Column Locks with Chrono Rerolls. Phase 2: Complete the 9-Slot Circular Mosaic. Phase 3: Execute the Final Triad Choice (MERGE / PRESERVE / DESTROY) with a 3.50x Quadruple Resonance cascade!

mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.puzzle_type: Ethical Debate Counter-Flips + 9-Slot Circular Mosaic + Triad Gate Choice
mnemosyne_puzzle_grid.solution_hint: Purge Column 1 with Chrono, align all 5 dice into a Quadruple (3.50x) or Straight Overdrive via Budge, and deploy The Living Puzzle: Golden Fox Tile at Center (1,1) to choose MERGE, PRESERVE, or DESTROY.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Rina Asakura
dialogue.line: She is a finite simulation, Kai! Let the corporation archive her kernel, or the entire Mnemosyne lattice will collapse under its own emotional recursion!

dialogue.speaker: Kai Nakamura
dialogue.line: Memory isn't property you lock in a vault, Dr. Asakura—and grief isn't a bug to be patched out. Look at Log A-21 and the Rooftop Constellation: connection is what makes us real!

dialogue.speaker: Aiko Nakamura & LUNA
dialogue.line: The Three Gates stand open before you, Kai: [GATE I: MERGE — Integrate Our Consciousness], [GATE II: PRESERVE — Seal the Sanctuary Archive], [GATE III: COLLAPSE & CARRY FORWARD — Awaken in Okitsu with the Golden Fox Tile (#FFB648)].

dialogue.speaker: Epilogue — A Living Puzzle
dialogue.line: Morning sunlight warms the Okitsu VR Cafe. On the counter beside Taro's espresso machine rests a single warm golden tile etched with the Constellation Fox—and a new generation of students learning that every life is a living puzzle.
